title: Compound Dilution Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: After transferring from the previous row, mix dilution.

steps.title: Prepare plates and layout
steps.instruction: Set up up to four 96‑well plates so that each column will hold one compound; stock compound will be placed in row A, a six‑step serial dilution will be performed down rows B‑G, and row H will contain pure DMSO. Use a P300 or P20 pipette, which the software will select automatically based on the required transfer volume and dilution factor. Provide an input CSV file formatted as in the supplied template.

steps.title: Define transfer plan
steps.instruction: Specify the number of compounds (maximum 36), the transfer volumes, the order in which compounds will be transferred, and the desired final volume and dilution factor for each column.

steps.title: Mix and transfer stock compounds
steps.instruction: In the Compound Management area, vortex or pipette‑mix each stock compound, then transfer the defined amount to the corresponding empty Compound Plate, placing the stock in row A of the appropriate column and following the order defined in the transfer plan.

steps.title: Repeat transfer for all plates
steps.instruction: Perform the mixing and transfer described in the previous step for every specified plate until all compounds are loaded.

steps.title: Check for air bubbles
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol, spin down the plate if needed, and visually inspect each well to confirm that no air bubbles are present.

steps.title: Add DMSO to dilution rows
steps.instruction: Using the reservoir, dispense the desired volume of DMSO into each well of rows B through H for every column; row H will therefore contain pure DMSO.

steps.title: Perform serial dilution
steps.instruction: For each dilution step (rows B‑G): transfer the calculated volume of liquid from the previous row to the next row, then mix the contents to ensure homogeneity.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the appropriate volume from the current row to the next lower row.
Mix the transferred well (e.g., by pipette‑mixing).

steps.title: Repeat dilution steps
steps.instruction: Using a multi‑channel or single‑channel pipette as appropriate, repeat the transfer‑and‑mix actions for a total of six serial dilutions (rows B‑G) for each compound column.
